name: Tony Medina as a duo: Going Down, the Freddie King standard
description: Tony Medina plays the Freddie King blues standard Going Down as a duo. He can play these songs on his own or with a bigger band.
more: A percussionist joins Tony for the duo, which gives him a little more rhythm and is a nice touch at a patio event or a reception. He sings B.B. King's The Thrill Is Gone, too, along with the rock and roll that came out of the blues.
